env.name: CHUNK_MIN_LENGTH
env.description: Minimum chunk length in characters (1-10000, defaults to 50). Chunks shorter than this threshold are filtered out during ingestion.

env.name: STORE_IMAGES
env.description: Store supported PDF and DOCX images during ingestion and return them with matched chunks (defaults to false).

env.name: EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX
env.description: Embed each chunk together with its document title, which can help when passages don't restate the topic the title names (defaults to false). After changing it, use a new DB_PATH or delete the index an

env.name: EMBED_HEADING_PREFIX
env.description: Add section headings to chunk embeddings when they fit (defaults to false). Independent of EMBED_TITLE_PREFIX. Re-ingest documents after changing it.

env.name: RAG_DEVICE
env.description: Execution device for the embedder (defaults to cpu). Passed straight to ONNX Runtime; see the Transformers.js device source for the supported backend names. If the requested device fails to initialize

env.name: RAG_DTYPE
env.description: Embedding quantization dtype for the embedder (defaults to fp32). Opt-in and pass-through; accepts any dtype the chosen model provides (fp32, fp16, q8, int8, ...). If the model has no variant for the

env.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
env.description: Keyword boost factor for hybrid search (0.0-1.0, defaults to 0.6). 0 means semantic similarity only; higher values increase the keyword-match contribution to the final score.

env.name: RAG_RERANK_CMD
env.description: External reranker command template. Use {query} and {top} for query text and result count; unset disables reranking.

env.name: RAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Time budget per rerank call in milliseconds (100-600000, defaults to 10000). On timeout the spawned command is killed and the pre-rerank ordering is returned.

servers.name: io.github.antonorlov/mcp-postgres-server
servers.title: PostgreSQL
servers.description: MCP server for PostgreSQL: local, Docker, RDS, Neon, Supabase, or behind an SSH bastion.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Full connection string (preferred). Supports sslmode in the URL.

env.name: PG_HOST
env.description: Database host (fallback when DATABASE_URL is not set).

env.name: PG_PORT
env.description: Database port.

env.name: PG_USER
env.description: Database user.

env.name: PG_PASSWORD
env.description: Database password.

env.name: PG_DATABASE
env.description: Database name.

env.name: PG_ALLOW_WRITE
env.description: When true, execute performs writes and reads are sent directly. Off (default) is read-only: execute refuses writes and each read runs in a READ ONLY transaction.

env.name: PG_SSLMODE
env.description: TLS mode. require/allow/prefer encrypt without verifying the certificate; verify-ca/verify-full verify it (supply a CA via PG_SSL_CA). Unlike libpq, allow/prefer do not fall back to plaintext, so a se

env.name: PG_SSL_CA
env.description: Path to a CA certificate file. Setting it by itself implies verify-full.

env.name: PG_ENABLE_RUNTIME_CONNECT
env.description: Register the connect_db tool (runtime credential switching).

env.name: PG_MAX_RESULT_BYTES
env.description: Byte budget for a query result sent to the model. Whole rows are kept while they fit; over the budget returnedRows < rowCount and truncated is true.

env.name: PG_STATEMENT_TIMEOUT
env.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds, applied to every session.

env.name: PG_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
env.description: Timeout in milliseconds for a single connect attempt (raise it for slow links or SSH tunnels).

env.name: PG_SSH_HOST
env.description: SSH bastion host. Setting it enables tunneling: the server reaches the database only through an SSH tunnel to this host. Needs the ssh2 optional dependency.

env.name: PG_SSH_PORT
env.description: SSH bastion port.

env.name: PG_SSH_USER
env.description: SSH username.

env.name: PG_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Path to a private key file. If unset, auth falls back like ssh: a running agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), then a default key (~/.ssh/id_ed25519, id_rsa, id_ecdsa).

env.name: PG_SSH_PASSPHRASE
env.description: Passphrase for the private key, if encrypted.

env.name: PG_SSH_AGENT
env.description: true to use the ambient agent (SSH_AUTH_SOCK), or an explicit socket path / Windows named pipe.

env.name: PG_SSH_PASSWORD
env.description: SSH login password. Opt-in; a key or agent takes precedence. Prefer keys, a bastion often disables password auth.

env.name: PG_SSH_FINGERPRINT
env.description: Pinned host-key fingerprint (SHA256:...). Host-key verification is mandatory and set only this way: without it the tunnel refuses to connect. Get it with ssh-keygen -lF host.

env.name: PG_SSH_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
env.description: SSH keepalive interval in ms; the tunnel drops after 3 unanswered keepalives, and the next call reconnects.
